title: One Step, Four Clocks: How GUI Agents Fall Out of Step
abstract: arXiv:2611.31522v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GUI agents can choose correct actions yet fail as interfaces change during deliberation. Latency alone cannot explain these failures because actions may become invalid at different interaction stages. We model four events: environment change, observation availability, decision commitment, and action receipt (EODA). We introduce ChronotopeGym to study these failures under Paused, Replay, and Live execution. Across five tasks, agents can fail in Live despite succeeding when responses remain valid, even when actions meet deadlines. On Moving Balloon, updating a pending click raises success from 0% to 100% without changing response time. Our accelerator-resident GUI controller, Chronotope, maintains compact interaction history and selectively keeps, updates, or redecides pending actions. Compared with Agent S3, Chronotope reduces median end-to-end latency by 85.5% for a 27B model, expanding its performance envelope to 100% Live success at an

translated_title: 一步四时钟：GUI智能体为何失步脱节
translated_abstract: GUI智能体能够选择正确的动作，却会在界面于决策期间发生变化时失败。仅凭延迟无法解释这些失败，因为动作可能在不同的交互阶段变得无效。我们建模了四个事件：环境变化、观测可用、决策提交和动作接收。我们引入ChronotopeGym，在暂停、重放和实时执行模式下研究这些失败。在五项任务中，即使动作满足截止时间、且响应保持有效时能够成功，智能体在实时模式下仍可能失败。在移动气球任务上，更新一个待执行的点击操作可将成功率从0%提升到100%，而响应时间保持不变。我们的驻留于加速器上的GUI控制器Chronotope维护紧凑的交互历史，并选择性地保留、更新或重新决策待执行动作。与Agent S3相比，Chronotope将27B模型的端到端中位延迟降低了85.5%，将其性能包络扩展至100%的实时成功率。
tldr: 该论文提出EODA四事件时间模型与ChronotopeGym基准，揭示GUI智能体在实时交互中因界面变化导致动作失效的根本原因，并设计驻留加速器的Chronotope控制器，通过选择性保留、更新或重决策待执行动作，将端到端延迟降低85.5%并实现100%实时成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper models GUI agent failures through four timing events (Environment change, Observation availability, Decision commitment, Action receipt), introduces ChronotopeGym to study them across Paused, Replay, and Live execution, and proposes Chronotope—an accelerator-resident controller that selectively keeps, updates, or redecides pending actions—reducing median end-to-end latency by 85.5% while achieving 100% Live success.
